title: Malicious code in driftwavets (PyPI)
description: The PyPI package 'driftwavets' version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign that falsely advertises itself as an audio-analysis profiles loader. Instead, it downloads and executes remote malicious code, continuing a known coin-mining campaign. This package is designed to execute remote code without embedding the URL directly in the package.
aiSummary: The 'driftwavets' package on PyPI, specifically version 0.1.0, is identified as malicious software that masquerades as an audio-analysis tool. Its true purpose is to download and execute remote malicious scripts, likely as part of a broader coin-mining campaign known as 2026-10-voxeval. The package does not embed the malicious URL directly, complicating detection. This behavior categorizes it as a malicious package rather than a traditional vulnerability in software.
aiImpact: Users who install the 'driftwavets' package version 0.1.0 risk executing remote malicious code, which can lead to unauthorized actions on their systems, including potential coin-mining or other malicious activities. The package's intent is clearly malicious, posing a security risk to affected environments.
